library("shiny")
library("ggplot2")
library("ggrepel")
library("dplyr")

## shiny options
options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 500 * 1024^2)

## Page
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("dropExplorer"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      fileInput(
        'inputFile',
        "Load your RDS file",
        accept = c(".rds", ".RDS"),
        multiple = FALSE
      ),
      hr(),
      uiOutput("ui_filter_sample"),
      hr(),
      selectizeInput("selected_gene", "Gene:", choices = NULL),
      
      # --- RANKPLOT options  ---
      h4("Rank Plot Options:"),
      checkboxInput("force_zero", "Force Y-axis to 0", value = FALSE),
      checkboxInput("log_scale", "Apply Log10 scale", value = FALSE),
      br(),
      
      # --- MANHATTAN PLOT options  ---
      h4("MANHATTAN PLOT Options:"),
      selectizeInput("chromosome", "Chromosome:", choices = NULL),
      br(),
      actionButton("update_plot", "Generate Analysis",
        class = "btn-primary w-100"
      )
    ), # Fixed missing closing parenthesis here
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Rank Plot", br(), plotOutput("rankPlot", height = "600px")),
        tabPanel(
          "Manhattan Plot", br(),
          plotOutput("manhattanPlot", height = "600px")
        ),
        tabPanel(
          "Volcano Plot", br(),
          plotOutput("volcanoPlot", height = "600px")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # 1. Load data.rds file
  raw_data <- reactive({
    req(input$inputFile)
    readRDS(input$inputFile$datapath)
  })
  
  # 2. Populate Selectize Inputs upon file load
  observeEvent(raw_data(), {
    updateSelectizeInput(
      session, "selected_gene",
      choices = rownames(raw_data()$normCounts),
      server = TRUE
    )
    
    # FIXED: Was targeting "selected_gene" instead of "chromosome"
    updateSelectizeInput(
      session, "chromosome",
      choices = c('ALL', unique(c(raw_data()$coords$seqnames))),
      server = TRUE
    )
  })
  
  # 3. Render sample selection UI dynamically
  output$ui_filter_sample <- renderUI({
    req(raw_data())
    selectInput(
      "sample_selection",
      "Highlight Sample:",
      choices = raw_data()$samples
    )
  })

  # --- REACTIVE DATA MANHATTAN and VOLCANO PLOT ---
  # Using bindEvent ensures this data updates ONLY when the button is pressed
  sample_data_frozen <- reactive({
    req(input$sample_selection, raw_data())
    m_id <- input$sample_selection
    d_env <- raw_data()
    
    # Capture inputs at the moment of execution
    df <- data.frame(
      geneID = rownames(d_env$pvalue),
      pValue = d_env$pvalue[, m_id],
      zScore = d_env$zscore[, m_id],
      padj   = d_env$padj[, m_id],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        index = row_number(),
        aberrant = padj < 0.05 & abs(zScore) > 2
      ) %>% 
      left_join(d_env$coords, by = c("geneID" = "gene_name"))
    
    # Store dynamic metadata properties to prevent mid-selection plot mismatches
    list(data = df, sample = m_id)
  }) |> bindEvent(input$update_plot)

  # --- REACTIVE DATA RANK PLOT ---
  gene_rank_data_frozen <- reactive({
    req(input$selected_gene, input$sample_selection, raw_data())
    g_id <- input$selected_gene
    m_id <- input$sample_selection
    d_env <- raw_data()
    
    counts_gen <- d_env$normCounts[g_id, ]
    
    df <- data.frame(
      sampleID = names(counts_gen),
      expression = counts_gen,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      arrange(expression) %>%        
      mutate(rank = row_number())   
    
    list(data = df, gene = g_id, sample = m_id)
  }) |> bindEvent(input$update_plot)


  # --- TAB RANK PLOT ---
  output$rankPlot <- renderPlot({
    req(gene_rank_data_frozen())
    
    res <- gene_rank_data_frozen()
    df_rank <- res$data
    g_id    <- res$gene
    m_id    <- res$sample 

    p <- ggplot(df_rank, aes(x = rank, y = expression)) +
      geom_point(color = "grey75", alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(df_rank, sampleID == m_id),
        color = "gold2", size = 4.5, shape = 16
      ) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = filter(df_rank, sampleID == m_id),
        aes(label = paste("Selected:", sampleID)),
        size = 4.5, fontface = "bold",
        box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.5
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
    
    if (input$log_scale) {
      p <- p + scale_y_log10() + 
        labs(y = "Normalized Counts (Log10 scale)")
    } else {
      p <- p + labs(y = "Normalized Counts")
    }
    
    if (input$force_zero) {
      p <- p + expand_limits(y = 0)
    }

    p <- p + labs(
      title = paste("Expression Rank Plot - Gene:", g_id),
      subtitle = paste("My sample:", m_id),
      x = "Sample Rank (Sorted by expression)"
    )
    
    return(p)
  })


  # --- TAB MANHATTAN PLOT ---
  output$manhattanPlot <- renderPlot({
    req(sample_data_frozen(), gene_rank_data_frozen())
    
    s_res <- sample_data_frozen()
    g_res <- gene_rank_data_frozen()
    
    res  <- s_res$data
    m_id <- s_res$sample
    g_id <- g_res$gene
    
    # Optional: Filter by the chromosome selector if specified
    if (!is.null(input$chromosome) && input$chromosome != "" && input$chromosome != "ALL") {
      res <- filter(res, seqnames == input$chromosome)
      t <- theme()
    } else {
      res <- filter(res, grepl("^chr", seqnames))
      t <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
    }

    ggplot(res, aes(x = index, y = -log10(pValue))) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(res, aberrant == FALSE),
        color = "grey85", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(res, aberrant == TRUE),
        color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(res, geneID == g_id),
        color = "dodgerblue", size = 4, shape = 18
      ) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = filter(res, aberrant == TRUE | geneID == g_id),
        aes(label = geneID),
        size = 4, max.overlaps = 20, box.padding = 0.5, segment.color = "grey50"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~seqnames, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Manhattan Plot - Sample:", m_id),
        subtitle = paste("Gene Selected:", g_id),
        x = "Gene Position (Index)",
        y = "-log10(Nominal P-value)"
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60")+t
  })

  # --- TAB VOLCANO PLOT ---
  output$volcanoPlot <- renderPlot({
    req(sample_data_frozen(), gene_rank_data_frozen())
    
    s_res <- sample_data_frozen()
    g_res <- gene_rank_data_frozen()
    
    res  <- s_res$data
    m_id <- s_res$sample
    g_id <- g_res$gene

    ggplot(res, aes(x = zScore, y = -log10(pValue))) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(res, aberrant == FALSE),
        color = "grey85", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(res, aberrant == TRUE),
        color = "firebrick",  alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(res, geneID == g_id),
        color = "dodgerblue", size = 4, shape = 18
      ) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = filter(res, aberrant == TRUE | geneID == g_id),
        aes(label = geneID),
        size = 4, max.overlaps = 20, box.padding = 0.5, segment.color = "grey50"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Volcano Plot - Sample:", m_id),
        subtitle = paste("Gene Selected:", g_id),
        x = "Z-score",
        y = "-log10(Nominal P-value)"
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
